summary: The diff adds a ValentineProposal React component with a pink/white theme, a Yes->success transition showing "Good choice", and logic to reposition the No button on hover/touch/pointer events. However, the provided meme image asset itself is not evidenced as added, and several unrelated/auth scaffolding and a footer attribution were introduced without being requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: The success view displays the provided/generated meme image reliably as a static asset in the frontend (not fetched from the backend).
missing_requirements.reason: The component references an image path ("/assets/generated/valentine-meme-good-choice.dim_1024x1024.png"), but the diff summary does not show the actual image file being added to the frontend static assets, so reliable inclusion as a static asset is not evidenced.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/changed Internet Identity + React Query actor/auth infrastructure (InternetIdentityProvider, useInternetIdentity, useActor) despite being a stated non-goal and also listed as immutable/not-to-edit files.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly lists Internet Identity/auth flows as non-goals and prohibits editing specific hook files and main.tsx; the diff adds these files and wires the provider into the app.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a footer with external attribution link to caffeine.ai and a copyright line.
hallucinated_features.reason: No requirement requests a footer or external attribution; the BuildRequest focuses only on the single interactive proposal screen behavior and theme.

hallucinated_features.description: Added an empty backend canister file (backend/main.mo).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-4 states no backend canister functionality is needed; while an empty actor adds no APIs, it is still an unrequested backend addition in the diff.
